acceptance_criteria.decision: joint intersection-union across both frozen-test strata
required_for_joint_superiority: effect is at least the minimum relevant reduction in both strata
all three paired seed differences are negative in both strata
one-sided 95% paired block-resampling upper bound is below zero in both strata
acceptance_criteria.result_if_not_met: negative or inconclusive finite-benchmark result; no superiority claim
acceptance_criteria.single_stratum_followup: exploratory only, with Holm adjustment across two strata

descriptor.features: MACE invariant node descriptors from all interaction layers
descriptor.normalization: current remaining pool only; population standardization, constant dimensions removed at 1e-12, then row L2 normalization with zero centroid preserved
descriptor.selection: deterministic farthest-point selection within the shortlist; centroid-farthest seed and lexicographic candidate-id ties

acquisition.disagreement: mean over atoms of population RMS Euclidean committee-force deviation (ddof=0)

tail_proxy.aggregation: mean of largest max(1, ceil(0.05 * n_atoms)) atomic proxy values
tail_proxy.atomic_proxy: norm(committee mean force) + population RMS vector disagreement
tail_proxy.name: label-free force-tail proxy
tail_proxy.warning: This is neither observed error nor calibrated uncertainty.

viability_gate_before_oracle_reveal.decision: stop and invoke the scientific fallback if the gate fails; do not improvise an ensemble after labels are revealed
viability_gate_before_oracle_reveal.minimum_median_disagreement: max(10 * calibrated force-component numerical floor, 1e-6 eV/angstrom)

claim_scope: paired finite-benchmark evidence conditional on the two named held-out Cu trajectories and one selected-label path per policy; no population-wide or universal Cu claim

vessl.credit_constraint: actual and planned remaining cost must stay within verified promotional balance

dataset.level_of_theory: VASP 5.4.1, PBE, PAW, 520 eV as source-paper stated
dataset.license: BSD-3-Clause repository-wide license with recorded residual data-license nuance
dataset.source: mlearn Cu benchmark from Zuo et al., DOI 10.1021/acs.jpca.9b08723
dataset.stress_labels: excluded because unit provenance remains inferred

frozen_test_policy.authorization: one simultaneous aggregate evaluation after all final model and analysis hashes are frozen
frozen_test_policy.guidance_prohibition: no frozen-test outcome may guide proposals, arm selection, retries, or hyperparameters
frozen_test_policy.models: all preregistered final VESSL models plus any preregistered cross-provider confirmation models
frozen_test_policy.reruns: only a documented infrastructure-failure retry with identical bytes and configuration

hypothesis: At the same 36-label budget, tail_risk_fps reduces mean-seed atomic force-vector P95 on both held-out AIMD-3000 K and vacancy-300 K strata by a scientifically relevant amount relative to disagreement_fps.

model.training_data_compatibility: same broad PBE/PBE+U foundation; exact target convention assessed by preregistered initial energy-offset diagnostic

novelty_claim: Within the 35-paper verified scoped search, no study directly tested a predicted-force-magnitude-plus-disagreement tail proxy against standard disagreement-plus-fixed-foundation-descriptor diversity under an equal tiny Cu label budget with separately held-out high-temperature bulk and ordered-vacancy tail endpoints. This is a scoped literature-gap inference, not proof of absolute novelty.
null_hypothesis: tail_risk_fps does not meet the preregistered relevant-effect and direction criteria relative to disagreement_fps in both held-out strata.

oracle.selection_inputs: structures, fixed-foundation descriptors, predictions, and label-free committee scores only

physical_checks.elastic_mode_6: protected energy-strain response: geometry-derived signed strain coordinate, reference and predicted relative-energy curves, near-origin quadratic-curvature ratio, minimum shift, force metrics, and softening slope
physical_checks.force_softening_slope: configuration-equal weighted no-intercept predicted-versus-reference force-component slope beta; report 1-beta and median force-magnitude difference
physical_checks.interpretation: diagnostic checks on this benchmark, not standalone experimental Cu-property estimates

primary_endpoint: for each frozen-test stratum, mean across seeds of numpy linear-method P95 atomic force-vector error in eV/angstrom
research_question: Under a fixed 36-label budget, does a preregistered label-free force-tail proxy select Cu configurations that reduce held-out tail force error and systematic force softening more reliably than standard committee-disagreement plus fixed-foundation MACE-descriptor diversity?
secondary_endpoints: force softening slope and signed magnitude bias
group-specific results without pooling held-out strata
committee disagreement/error Spearman association on validation
selected-set descriptor diversity and group coverage
runtime, peak GPU memory, and failed runs

initial_labeled.groups: elastic_ground_state, elastic_mode_1, and 11 deterministic surface groups

pool.groups: aimd_nvt_1000k, vacancy_3000k, elastic_mode_2 through elastic_mode_5, and one remaining surface

statistical_design.interval_name: paired block-resampling sensitivity interval conditional on the two trajectories
statistical_design.pseudoreplication_warning: frames, atoms, components, and committee members are nested measurements, not acquisition-policy replicates
statistical_design.seed_reporting: show every seed; SD describes optimization variability conditional on one selected path

stopping_and_pivot.fixed_rounds: run all three rounds for all four active arms; no validation-driven arm dropping
stopping_and_pivot.pivot: only before pool-label reveal if committee viability fails, required inputs are absent, the full-epoch calibration exceeds the sealed budget, or a methodological assumption is falsified
stopping_and_pivot.scientific_fallback: same-shortlist comparison of top committee disagreement versus top-36 disagreement plus deterministic MACE-descriptor FPS
stopping_and_pivot.stop: after independent cross-provider confirmation and the one frozen final evaluation answer the question, or when budget/credit makes any further decisive experiment impossible

training.early_stopping: disabled scientifically by patience equal to 20 fixed epochs; final epoch is used
training.learning_rate_fallback: 0.00025 only if the outcome-blind D0 training viability run is non-finite before any pool label reveal; if used, apply uniformly to every fit
training.max_optimizer_steps: 20 * ceil(n_train / 4), recomputed exactly per cumulative label budget
training.restart_policy: every arm, round, and seed restarts from the identical foundation checkpoint; no warm start
